name: ds_prob_active
description: Probability of activity against drug-susceptible M. tuberculosis H37Rv from an ExtraTrees classifier (active is MIC below 5 uM and inactive above 15 uM in training; the authors' calibrated decision threshold is 0.4375)

name: dr_prob_active
description: Probability of activity against drug-resistant M. tuberculosis isolates from a histogram gradient boosting classifier (active is MIC below 5 uM and inactive above 15 uM in training; the authors' calibrated decision threshold is 0.6511)

name: ds_pmic
description: Predicted pMIC (minus log10 of the MIC in mol/L; higher means more potent) against drug-susceptible M. tuberculosis from an ExtraTrees regressor trained on 21683 compounds (pooled out-of-fold RMSE 0.714)

name: ds_pmic90
description: Predicted pMIC (minus log10 of the MIC90 in mol/L; higher means more potent) against drug-susceptible M. tuberculosis from a LightGBM regressor trained on 3754 compounds (pooled out-of-fold RMSE 0.682)

name: ds_pmic99

name: dr_pmic

name: dr_pmic90
description: Predicted pMIC (minus log10 of the MIC90 in mol/L; higher means more potent) against drug-resistant M. tuberculosis from an ExtraTrees regressor trained on 561 compounds (pooled out-of-fold RMSE 0.784)

name: dr_pmic99
description: Predicted pMIC (minus log10 of the MIC99 in mol/L; higher means more potent) against drug-resistant M. tuberculosis from an ExtraTrees regressor trained on 180 compounds (pooled out-of-fold RMSE 0.604); few training compounds so treat with caution
